candidates.page: List of flags of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
candidates.file: Flag of the Congo Free State.svg
candidates.text: ! scope="row" rowspan="4" | | align=" " | 1876–1879 | International African Association | rowspan="4" | Blue background emblazoned with a central yellow five-pointed star | rowspan="4" | The blue background symbolises the Congo River and the yellow star (which is still used) symbolises both unity, and a bright future. It was the only flag used during the entire period of colonial Belgian administration.

candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | align=" " | 1960–1963 | rowspan="2" | First Congolese Republic | An additional six yellow five-pointed stars are added to the hoist |The added stars represent the six state provinces existing at the time of independence from Belgium.

candidates.page: List of flags of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
candidates.file: Flag of the Republic of the Congo (Léopoldville) (1963–1966).svg
candidates.text: ! scope="row" rowspan="2" | | align=" " | 1963–1964 | rowspan="2" | A yellow five-pointed star sitting alongside a red and gold bend sinister on a blue background | rowspan="2" | The red bend represents the blood of martyrs, and the gold frame represents the riches of the land.
